name: Lucky Tiles Mahjong (The Atelier)
description: Boutique mahjong studio inside Linden Tree Gifts in Noblesville (Indianapolis metro) run by Lauren Price; lessons, open play, leagues and events. Own page says: "We play American mahjong using the current National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) card."
schedule: Open play Monday-Saturday 10am-6pm, reservations required; $25 per two-hour session for non-members (page wording). Class dates are on the studio's Acuity scheduling page (not readable here).
